llm_fields.description: The scheme provides a financial incentive of ₹50,000 to Scheduled Tribe individuals residing in Karnataka who marry another Scheduled Tribe individual, aiming to reduce marriage expenses, prevent dowry, and promote a more accepting society.
llm_fields.eligibility: Both partners must reside in Karnataka, belong to the Scheduled Tribe community, have a combined annual income less than ₹2,00,000, the marriage must have taken place on or after 11 August 2015, and the application must be submitted within one year of marriage.
